document.title: Azizi Florence
document.summary: A planned residential community in Sharjah alongside Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311), with villa and townhouse designs, planned landscaped parkland and leisure amenities.
keyFeatures: A Sharjah community alongside Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311)
Four-, five- and six-bedroom villa designs over three floors
Three- and four-bedroom townhouse designs
Townhouses arranged in four-, six- and eight-home groups
Contemporary and Mediterranean-inspired residential clusters
Planned landscaped parkland, recreation and neighbourhood amenities
amenities: Gyms, sauna, steam and jacuzzi facilities

children.text: Azizi Florence is planned to bring together apartments, villas and townhouses in Sharjah alongside Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311), with landscaped parkland and neighbourhood amenities throughout the community.

The villa designs comprise four-, five- and six-bedroom homes over three floors. The townhouse designs include three- and four-bedroom homes arranged in four-, six- and eight-home groups, with a choice of corner and middle layouts.

Planned community amenities include landscaped gardens, walking, running and cycling routes, sports courts, children’s play areas, clubhouses, swimming pools, fitness and wellness facilities, cafés and electric-vehicle charging. These are community proposals, not confirmation of facilities included with every home.

children.text: A three-bedroom terraced house in North London, offered for sale through Haus of Estate at an asking price of £500,000. Haus has confirmed this is a ready property. The supplied imagery includes existing views and a separate interior design proposal.

The proposed interiors explore ideas for the living and dining space, kitchen and bathroom areas. AI-assisted visuals illustrate possible furnishing, lighting and finishes; they do not show completed renovation works or confirm what is included in the sale.
Images labelled BEFORE show the existing views supplied with the proposal. Images labelled AFTER show proposed design concepts. Current condition and any proposed works must be verified separately.

The supplied floor plan states an approximate gross internal floor area of 889.9 sq ft / 82.67 m². It shows three bedrooms and a bathroom on the first floor, with a living room, kitchen and separate WC on the ground floor, plus a front garden and backyard. Measurements are approximate and for guidance only; the internal floor area is not the plot size.
